statement.p: Consider each of the atomic processes below. Count the number of outcomes possible. As a reminder, atomic processes cannot be decomposed into smaller, sub-processes.

ol.li: When rolling a single 20-sided die, there are outcomes possible.
When rolling a single 60-sided die, there are outcomes possible.
When choosing a single donut from a donut shop that sells 25 different types of donut, there are outcomes possible.
When dealing out a single card from a standard 52-card deck, there are outcomes possible.
When dealing out a second card from a standard 52-card deck after a first card has been dealt out, there are outcomes possible.
